seed_variation.verdict: Only one seed was run, so there is no seed variation to measure.
seed_variation.why: BART decodes with beam search (do_sample=False), so on the same hardware it is deterministic too. Differences between seeds can only come from nondeterministic float math (e.g. GPU kernels, thread scheduling), which can flip a beam choice and change a few words. Each seed sets Python random, NumPy and torch. PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed to the FIRST seed for the whole run.
